MappingPage                                      baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
`-- MappingPocPage(services) -> MappingWorkspacePage
    |-- supplied services
    |   |-- diagrams: DiagramService                         sole content writer
    |   |   `-- create / revise / generate -> DiagramRevisionResult
    |   |       `-- issued diagram + revision + prepared edit correspondence
    |   `-- canvasHistory: CanvasHistoryService              owns history
    |       |-- openContext(document, view, history?) -> CanvasEditingContext
    |       |   `-- contextId; runtime handle -> CanvasHistory via WeakMap
    |       `-- resolve / append / navigate / fork / persistenceChanges
    |
    |-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace                          owns session lifetimes
    |   |-- store.drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
    |   |   |-- metadata
    |   |   |   |-- name / representationId? / revisionId / hidden? / busy
    |   |   |   `-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges? / viewport? / focusBox?
    |   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
    |   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController    owns domain state
    |   |       |   |-- context: CanvasEditingContext        history-service handle
    |   |       |   |-- getSnapshot() -> ControllerSnapshot
    |   |       |   |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
    |   |       |   |   |-- canUndo / canRedo / cell? / endpointBounds?
    |   |       |   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
    |   |       |   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox             recursive placement
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- id / position / minimumSize? / collapsed
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- collapsedContentId? -> contents
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- diagram -> contentId -> contents
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   `-- container -> children[]: GridBox
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |       `-- layout: push-right / gap
    |   |       |   |   |   |   `-- contents[contentId]: Diagram
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |-- diagramId / revisionId; local id / revision
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |-- content: DiagramContent
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   |-- revisionId / ascii / asciiSha256
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   `-- structure
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |       |-- diagram
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |       `-- tree: parserVersion / rootIds
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |           `-- nodes: parent/children/foldRanges
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |-- sourceContext: binding? / contentHash
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   `-- mappings[] -> evidence -> sourceRanges
    |   |       |   |   |   |       `-- jumps?: DiagramJump[]
    |   |       |   |   |   `-- edges[]: DiagramConnection / jumps? / sections
    |   |       |   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
    |   |       |   |       |-- selection.items[]: SelectionItem
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- id / displayNodeId       membership + order
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- no region -> whole diagram instance
    |   |       |   |       |   `-- region -> captured ASCII / rect / selectedIds
    |   |       |   |       |-- diagramViews?               per-diagram folding
    |   |       |   |       |-- display: DisplayState       floating ownership tree
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- rootIds / nodes[id]: FloatingPane
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- common: childIds / expansion / pixel geometry
    |   |       |   |       |   |   `-- geometryPolicy / expandedGeometry?
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- selection -> captured region / displayMode
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- projection -> title / revision refs / content
    |   |       |   |       |   |   `-- call-tree | compaction | source-code
    |   |       |   |       |   |       | code-panel
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- conversation -> thread / draft / canvasAnchor
    |   |       |   |       |   |   `-- presentation: compact | floating | docked
    |   |       |   |       |   `-- detail -> title / ascii / sectionId?
    |   |       |   |       `-- controls: activeBoxId / selectionFocusId
    |   |       |   |           `-- activeThreadId / surfaces[id]: action/prompt UI
    |   |       |   |-- nodes() -> CanvasDisplayNode[]        derived, cloned registry
    |   |       |   |   |-- common: id / version / childIds / expansion / collapsible
    |   |       |   |   |-- grid: diagram | group             bounds in cells
    |   |       |   |   |-- floating: FloatingPane            geometry in pixels
    |   |       |   |   `-- floating: arrow <- document.edges geometry in pixels
    |   |       |   `-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations) / select / undo
    |   |       |       `-- validate + update -> history append -> notify subscribers
    |   |       `-- readable stores                         publish controller refs
    |   |           |-- document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry
    |   |           `-- status: isDirty / sceneDirty / canUndo / canRedo
    |   |-- controllers[documentId] -> session.controller    borrowed lookup index
    |   |-- changes.version / dirtyScenes.ids               derived subscriptions
    |   `-- setDrafts / copyDocument / dispose               create, fork, retire sessions
    |
    |-- activeId / catalog snapshot / transfers[] / pendingTransfer / page UI state
    |-- viewState: SourcePaneViewState                      owns live scroll + camera
    |   `-- captureDisplay / captureCamera                  sample for saving/copying
    |
    |-- persistence: WorkspacePersistence                  reads workspace + viewState
    |   |-- workspace.onPersist(ids) -> sync(ids)
    |   |   `-- metadata + baseline + history deltas + canvas + viewport + index
    |   `-- viewState.subscribe(id) -> syncView(id)          canvas/viewport records
    |-- storage: WorkspaceStorage                          injected or page-created
    |   |-- records: RecordStorage                         cache + pending batches
    |   |-- worker: Worker                                 transport; sibling of records
    |   `-- records.batch -> flush -> worker write -> acknowledgement / retry
    |
    |-- capture() -> MappingWorkspaceSnapshot               explicit full capture
    |   |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId? / transfers?
    |   `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
    |       `-- metadata + saved baseline + document + canvas + history + viewport
    |-- transfer(copy | move) / linked undo-redo
    |   `-- prepare histories -> storage.save -> installWorkspace after acknowledgement
    `-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> handleAgentCommand
        |-- context -> { version, name, nodes: controller.nodes(), edges }
        |-- apply -> controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
        |-- apply-diagram-revision -> receiver -> persistence.sync -> storage.flush
        `-- workspace subscriptions -> publish live canvas selections
